scope: M1 seed restored and expanded during M3. Original splits and acceptance targets are unchanged. No visual encoder or image-query quality is measured; this sample cannot satisfy the release gates.

restore.originals: Prefer verified originals from the local media archive via archive_media_id when present. Otherwise GET capture_url (or url) into local_path; require HTTP 200 image content and matching SHA256. Do not substitute changed bytes after an upstream update.
restore.derivatives: Restore parent first, then crop_box_xyxy without scaling. Original captures are JPEG; derivatives are PNG. The recorded SHA256 values pin the local copies.
restore.derivative_encoder: Windows .NET System.Drawing.Bitmap.Clone(Rectangle(left, top, right-left, bottom-top), parent.PixelFormat), saved with System.Drawing.Imaging.ImageFormat.Png.
restore.secrets: No authentication material is stored in this fixture. Read source-scoped runtime credentials only if a future original request requires them.

split_policy.method: Fixed explicit assignments by conservatively grouped underlying photograph; frozen before model selection.
split_policy.gallery: Only captured gallery assets may enter a benchmark image index. The same entity can occur in all splits, but its query photographs cannot.
split_policy.exclusions: Exclude every development/evaluation photo group and all cross-source copies, resized copies, crops and other derivatives from the image index, even after full media capture. Missing near-duplicate checks block a held-out quality claim.
split_policy.development: May tune retrieval and thresholds; never move its photos to evaluation.
split_policy.evaluation: Reserved for evaluation after choices are frozen. Multiple cases from one photograph are one independent sample, not extra observations.
split_policy.pending_media: Pending cases are excluded from scored metrics. All seed images are captured and inspected; Bofors and Dunay diagram cases still lack suitable independent gallery references.
split_policy.cropping: crop_box_xyxy uses original decoded pixel coordinates and exclusive right/bottom bounds; derivatives inherit the parent's split and photo group.

review.agent: All 27 fixture images were visually inspected, including seven Commons originals restored during M3. Captions and entity associations were checked against archived evidence. No domain expert or user verification of these labels has occurred.
limitations: Source labels identify record-level families; exact vehicle/aircraft variants are not independently established.
Some images retain readable model labels and depict multiple examples of the same family. Cropped controls remove publisher model-name overlays, not all natural markings.
Cross-source visual deduplication has not run; the eventual evaluation index must enforce photo-group exclusion before any unseen-view claim.

The 1L122E and 1L122-2E pairs use distinct exposures but share an exhibition context across development and evaluation. They do not establish independent capture-session coverage, and both variants can appear in one frame.

Bofors and Dunay diagram queries are captured but unscored until suitable independent gallery references exist. The Dunay drawing may derive from the KH-7 reconnaissance family; keep the full scene and its crops out of that case gallery until resolved.

No-match images are easy controls only; realistic unrelated equipment remains needed. The Al Zarrar/Type 96 contrast is a related tank-class distractor, not a demonstrated sibling-variant distinction.
